facts.text: Robotic Trenching Arm & Rasp was deployed at Vastitas Borealis during Phoenix in 2008.

A 2.35-metre articulated robotic arm made of titanium and carbon composite, equipped with a backhoe scoop, a tungsten-carbide rasp, and a thermal and electrical conductivity probe (TECP). It dug trenches up to 18 cm deep.
Engineered specifically to operate in the harsh vacuum and extreme temperatures of the Martian environment.
Excavated the 'Snow White' and 'Dodo-Goldilocks' trenches, exposing pure white water-ice sheets 5 centimetres below the regolith.
Status: Remains preserved in the arid regolith at Vastitas Borealis.
First machine to directly touch and scrape extraterrestrial water ice, delivering ice shavings into laboratory ovens.
